m: अभि-लाप m. expression, word, Sāh. &c.
declaration (as of the object of a vow), Kād. (cf. अभीलापलप्.)
a: अभिलापः — 1 Expression, word, speech; Ki. 10. 61. --2 Declaration, mention, specification; न च स्मार्तमतद्धर्माभिलापात् Br. Sūt. --3 Declaration of the object of a vow or religious obligation.

s: puM, (aBi + las + BAve GaY .) aBilAzaH । icCA । ityamarawIkAsArasundarI ॥
puM, (aBi + lU + BAve GaY .) CedanaM । ityamaraH ॥
m: अभि-लाव m. (√ लू), cutting, reaping, mowing, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 28.
a: अभिलावः — [लू-घञ् P. III. 3. 28] Cutting, reaping, mowing.

k.v: लवोऽभिलावो लवने निष्पावः पवने पवः। प्रस्तावः स्यादवसरस्त्रसरः सूत्रवेष्टनम्.।

m: अभि-लाष (or less correctly अभि-लास), अस्, m. (ifc. f(आ). ), desire, wish, covetousness, affection (with loc. or ifc.)
a: अभिलाषः — (˚सः sometimes) A desire, wish, longing for, craving after; affection, longing of a lover, love, (usually with loc. of the object of desire); अतोऽभिलाषे प्रथमं तथाविधे मनो बबंध R. 3. 4; भव हृदय साभिलाषं Ś. 1. 28; Me. 110 साभिलाषं निर्वर्ण्य Ś. 3 casting a coveting or wistful look; न खलु सत्यमेव शकुंतलायां म माभिलाषः Ś. 2, Pt. 5. 67; sometimes with प्रति and acc., or in comp.

k.v: कामोऽभिलाषस्तर्षश्च सोऽत्यर्थं लालसा द्वयोः। उपाधिर्ना धर्मचिन्ता पुंस्याधिर्मानसी व्यथा॥

m: अभि-लाषक mfn. wishing, desiring (with acc.), R.
a: अभिलाषक, --लाषि(सि)न्, --लाषुक — a. Wishing or desiring for (with acc., loc. or in comp.); desirous, covetous, greedy of; यदार्यमस्यामभिलाषि मे मनः Ś. 1. 22; जलाभिलाषी जलमाददानां R. 2. 6; 3. 36; Me. 78; जयमत्रभवान्नूनमरातिष्वभिलाषुकः Ki. 11. 18; Śi. 15. 59.

m: अभि-लाषिन् mfn. id. (with loc. or ifc.), Śāk. &c.; (less correctly अभि-लासिन्, Megh. &c.)

m: अभि-लाषुक mf(आ)n. id. (with acc. [Kir.] or ifc. [Kathās.])

k.v: सर्वान्नीनस्तु सर्वान्नभोजी गृध्नुस्तु  गर्धनः। लुब्धोऽभिलाषुकस्तृष्णक्समौ लोलुपलोलुभौ॥

m: अभि-√ ली -लीयते, to adhere to, cling to (acc.), MBh.; Daś.
a: अभिली — {c4c} A. To enter into, lurk or lie hid into; कपिलाशवस्य क्रोडमभ्यलीयत Dk. 6.

m: अभि-लीन mfn. adhering to, clinging to (acc.), Megh. &c.
‘adhered to’, chosen (as a seat by birds or bees), Hariv.; Ragh. iii, 8.
a: अभिलीन — a. 1 Adhering or clinging to, attached to; R. 3. 8. --2 Embracing, shrouding; Me. 36.

m: अभि-लूता f. a kind of spider, Suśr.
अभि-√ लभ् Ā. to take or lay hold of BhP.; to reach, obtain, gain, MBh. &c.: Desid. (p. P. -लिप्सत्) to intend to catch or obtain, MBh. i, 2940.

a: अभिलंघ् — {c1c} {c10c} P. 1 To jump across or over; Ms. 4. 54; Y. 1. 137. --2 To attack, rush upon or over, fly at; तत्रभवत्या वदनमभिलंघति मधुकरः Ś. 6. --3 To violate, transgress; to offend, injure.
अभिलंघनं — Jumping across or over, flying at.

m: अभि-√ लङ्घ् Caus. to jump across or over; to transgress, violate; to injure, MBh. xii, 3565.

v: na॰ aBi + laGi--BAve lyuw । ullaNGane । “trayARAmeva BUtAnAM sAgarasyABilaNGane” rAmA॰ ।
m: अभि-लङ्घन n. jumping over (gen.), R.
violating, acting contrary to (in comp.), MBh. xiii, 2194.
अभि-लङ्घिन् mfn. violating, acting contrary to (in comp.), MBh. xiii, 4964.
अभि-√ लक्ष् Pass. -लक्ष्यते, to appear, MBh. viii, 1045.
अभि-लक्षण n. the act of marking (with signs), Hcat.
अभि-लक्षित mfn. fixed or indicated by (as by special signs)
determined for, selected as, MBh. xii, 13223
indicated, pointed out, R. ii, 57, 2
appearing, visible, Hariv.
(अन्- or न neg.) unseen, unperceived, MBh. i, 5822; Yājñ. iii, 59.
a: अभिलक्षित — a. Marked with signs, bearing marks.

m: अभिलक्ष्यी-कृत्य ind.p. (√ 1. कृ), aiming at a mark, directing towards.

v: tri॰ aBilakzyate uddiSyate aBi + lakza Ryat । 1 uddeSye । lakzyasya SaravyasyABimuKyam avyayI॰ । 2 SaravyABimuKye avya॰ । “SabdaM pratigajaprepsuraBilakzyamapAtayam” raGuH । lyap । 3 lakzyIkftyetyarTe avya॰ ।
m: अभि-लक्ष्य mfn. to be fixed or indicated by, distinguishable through (in comp.)
a: अभिलक्ष्य — a. To be marked or noted. --क्ष्यं ind. Towards a mark or aim.

m: अभि-लक्ष्यम् ind. towards a mark or aim, R. ii, 63, 23.
अभि-लम्भ m. acquisition, Nalac.
अभि-√ लप् to talk or speak about, AitBr.; KauṣBr.
a: अभिलप् — {c1c} P. To talk to or ad dress; अभिलपतश्च द्वारनिहितलोचनौ Mk. 2.

m: अभि-लप्य mfn. See निर्-अभिलप्य.
अभि-√ लष् -लषति, to desire or wish for (acc.), covet, crave.
a: अभिलष् — {c1c} {c4c} P. To desire or wish for, long for, covet, crave or yearn after; तेन दत्तमभिलेषुरंगनाः R. 19. 12; मानुषानभिलष्यंती Bk. 4. 22.

v: tri॰ aBi + laza--karmmaRi anIyar । kAmye । ezwavye । tavya । aBilazitavyo'pyatra tri॰ ।
m: अभि-लषणीय mfn. desirable, to be coveted.
अभि-लषण n. craving after, desiring.
अभि-लषितार्थ-चिन्तामणि m. N. of an encyclopaedia by Bhū-loka-malla Someśvaradeva (who reigned from 1127-1138 A.D.).

v: tri॰ aBi + laza--karmmaRi kta । 1 izwe aBilAzavizaye । BAve kta । 2 aBilAze icCAyAm na॰ ।
m: अभि-लषित mfn. desired, wished
अभि-लषित n. desire, wish, will.
a: अभिलषित — p. p. Desired, wished, longed for. --तं Desire, wish, will, pleasure; यथाभिलषितं अनुष्ठीयतां Pt. 1.

m: अभि-लेखन n. writing upon, inscribing.
अभि-लेखित n. a written document, Yājñ. ii, 149.
अभि-√ लिख् to engrave, write upon, draw, paint : Caus. to cause to paint, have anything painted, Kathās.; to cause to write down, Yājñ. i, 318.

a: अभिलिखित — a. Written, inscribed. --तं, अभिलेखनं 1 Writing, inscribing. --2 A writing.

m: अभि-√ लिप् to smear with, TS.; Kauś. : Caus. id., MBh. xiii, 7427.
अभि-लिप्सा f. desire of obtaining.
अभि-√ लोक् Caus. (p. -लोकयत्) to view, look at (from a height), R. vi, 2, 7.
अभि-√ लुभ् Caus. -लोभयति, to entice, allure.
अभि-लुलित mfn. touched or grazed by (anything)
shaken about, agitated, Śāk.
a: अभिलुलित — a. 1 Agitated, disturbed. --2 Playful, unsteady.

m: अभि-√ लुप् (p. -लुम्पत्) to rob, plunder, BhP.
अभि-लुप्त mfn. disturbed, injured.
